title: Bujurgon Ka Health Checkup — Senior Citizen Test, Deoria
description: 60 saal ke baad kaun se blood test zaroori hain, saal me kitni baar, dawa ke saath kaun si jaanch, aur Deoria me maa-baap ka sample ghar par kaise dilayein.
keywords: 60 saal ke baad kaun se test karaye
senior citizen blood test at home
takeaways: 60 ke baad sugar, kidney, khoon ki kami, thyroid aur vitamin ki kami aksar bina lakshan ke badhti hain. Saal me ek baar poori jaanch inhe jaldi pakad leti hai.
Jo bujurg roz dawa lete hain, unki jaanch dawa ke hisaab se hoti hai — sugar ki dawa par B12, BP ki dawa par kidney aur potassium, dard ki goli par creatinine.
Garmi, dast ya BP ki peshab wali goli ke saath achanak uljhan ya chakkar aaye to sodium gira ho sakta hai — ye usi din aspataal ka maamla hai.
Bujurg ko khaali pet safar karana sabse zyada thakata hai. Deoria me sample ghar par, subah 6 baje se, aur report beta-beti ke phone par bhi aa sakti hai.

sections.heading: 60 Ke Baad Health Checkup Kyun — Jo Beemari Bina Awaaz Ke Aati Hai
sections.lead: Bujurgon me "sab theek hai" aur "sab theek hai, bas thodi thakan hai" ke beech ka farak aksar report me hi dikhta hai.
blocks: Umar ke saath kai cheezein dheere badalti hain — kidney ki taaqat ghatti hai, sugar chupke se badhta hai, haemoglobin girta hai, thyroid sust ho jaata hai, aur haddiyon ke liye Vitamin D kam pad jaata hai. Inme se zyadatar ka koi saaf lakshan nahi hota, ya lakshan "budhaape" me gin liye jaate hain: thakan, bhookh kam, neend kam, ghutno me dard, bhoolna.

Deoria me ek aur haqeeqat hai. Bahut se gharon me bete-betiyaan Delhi, Mumbai, Surat, Punjab ya Khadi deshon me kaam karte hain, aur maa-baap gaon ya kasbe me akele rehte hain. Aise me checkup "jab ghar aayenge tab karayenge" par tal jaata hai — aur saal nikal jaata hai. Ghar par sample ka sabse bada faayda yahi hai ki jaanch kisi ke aane ka intezaar nahi karti.
Door rehkar maa-baap ki jaanch kaise karayein — booking, payment aur report door se kaise sambhaalein — uska poora kram

sections.heading: Bujurgon Me Sodium Kam — Garmi Me Uljhan Aur Chakkar Ka Chhupa Kaaran
sections.lead: Purvanchal ki garmi aur umas me ye sabse zyada chhoot jaane wali baat hai.
blocks: May-June ki garmi aur barsaat ki umas me bujurg paseene me namak kho dete hain. Upar se agar BP ki peshab badhane wali goli chal rahi ho, ya dast-ulti ho jaaye, to khoon me sodium gir sakta hai. Iska lakshan aksar "umar ka asar" samajh liya jaata hai — uljhan, baat samajh na aana, bahut susti, chakkar, girna, aur gambhir haalat me daure.

note.title: Ye usi din ka maamla hai
note.text: Kisi bujurg me achanak uljhan, behoshi jaisi susti, baar-baar girna ya daura dikhe to ghar par test book karne ka intezaar mat kijiye — seedha aspataal le jaaiye. Wahan sodium turant jaancha jaata hai.

blocks: Routine me — jab tabiyat theek ho — BP ki dawa par chal rahe bujurgon me doctor saal me ek-do baar sodium-potassium dekh lete hain. Garmi shuru hone se pehle ek baar karana samajhdaari hai.

sections.heading: Bujurg Ka Blood Sample Ghar Par — Fasting, Patli Nas Aur Bistar Par Mareez
sections.lead: Umar ke saath nas patli aur chhupi hui ho jaati hai. Thodi taiyaari se sample ek baar me ho jaata hai.

list: Raat se saada paani peete rahiye — paani ki kami me nas sabse mushkil milti hai.
Subah ka pehla slot lijiye, taaki bhookh ka samay chhota rahe. Sugar ke mareez ko fasting me chakkar aaye to turant kuch meetha dijiye.
Sugar ki goli ya insulin sample ke baad; BP ki goli samay par.
Kamra garam rakhiye aur haath par garam kapda — thand me nas sikud jaati hai.
Khoon patla karne wali dawa chal rahi ho to phlebotomist ko bataiye — sui ki jagah der tak dabayi jaayegi.
Bistar par mareez ya chal nahi paate — booking ke waqt bata dijiye; sample bistar par hi liya jaata hai.

sections.heading: Jo Jaanch Blood Test Nahi Hai — ECG, Aankh, Haddi Aur X-Ray
sections.lead: Poora senior checkup sirf khoon ka nahi hota.
blocks: Bujurgon ke saal ke checkup me doctor aksar kuch aur jaanch bhi kehte hain — ECG (dil), aankh ki jaanch (motiyabind, glaucoma, sugar ka aankh par asar), BP naapna, haddi ki majbooti (BMD), aur kabhi X-ray ya ultrasound. Ye sab machine aur doctor par hoti hain.

note.title: Ye hamari service nahi hai
note.text: MedicoBharat Deoria me sirf khoon aur peshab ke sample ghar par leta hai. ECG, X-ray, ultrasound, aankh ya haddi ki jaanch hum nahi karte. Sahi kram: blood test ghar par kara lijiye, aur report le kar doctor ke paas jaaiye — ek hi visit me doctor sab dekh lenge.

sections.heading: Maa-Baap Ki Jaanch Ka Saal Bhar Ka Plan — Tyohaar Par Ghar Aane Ka Faayda
sections.lead: Jaanch ko ek tareekh se baandh dijiye, taaki wo tale nahi.
blocks: Deoria me pravasi parivaar aam taur par Holi, Chhath ya Diwali par ghar aate hain. Us hafte ka ek din maa-baap ke checkup ke liye rakh lijiye — sample subah ghar par, report agle din phone par, aur chhutti khatam hone se pehle doctor ko dikha bhi dijiye. Isse report ke baad ka kaam bhi aapke saamne ho jaata hai.

faqs.question: 60 saal ke baad kaun se blood test karane chahiye?
faqs.answer: Aam taur par CBC, fasting sugar aur HbA1c, kidney function test, lipid profile, liver function test, TSH, Vitamin D, Vitamin B12 aur urine routine. BP ki dawa ho to sodium-potassium bhi. Doctor aapki beemari aur dawa ke hisaab se isme badlav karte hain.

faqs.question: Bujurgon ko health checkup kitni baar karana chahiye?
faqs.answer: Koi badi beemari na ho to saal me ek baar poori jaanch. Sugar ho to HbA1c har 3 mahine, aur sugar ya BP ki dawa par kidney aur potassium har 6 mahine — ya jaisa doctor kahein.

faqs.question: Senior Citizen Pack me kya aata hai aur kitne ka hai?
faqs.answer: Senior Citizen Pack 55 saal se upar walon ke liye sugar, dil aur haddiyon ki jaanch par kendrit package hai. Isme kaun se test hain aur aaj ka daam kya hai, wo Deoria ki rate list par package ke card par dekhiye.

faqs.question: Sugar ki dawa metformin lene walon ko B12 test kyun karana chahiye?
faqs.answer: Metformin lambe samay tak lene se kai logon me Vitamin B12 ghat jaata hai, jisse haath-pair me jhunjhuni, kamzori aur khoon ki kami ho sakti hai. Isliye metformin par saal me ek baar B12 dekhna samajhdaari hai.

faqs.question: Bujurgon me sodium kam hone ke lakshan kya hain?
faqs.answer: Uljhan, baat samajh na aana, bahut susti, chakkar, girna aur gambhir haalat me daure. Garmi, dast-ulti aur BP ki peshab wali goli se khatra badhta hai. Aise lakshan achanak aayein to seedha aspataal jaaiye.

faqs.question: Deoria me bujurgon ka blood test ghar par ho sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Haan. Deoria Sadar, Rudrapur, Barhaj, Salempur, Bhatpar Rani, Gauri Bazar, Baitalpur, Lar aur Bhatni me sample ghar par liya jaata hai. Home collection free, slot subah 6 baje se, aur report 24 ghante ke andar WhatsApp aur email par PDF me.
